source.title: Show HN: Let your AI agents paint big arrows, boxes and text on your screen
source.author: franze

title.en: bigarrow: AI Agents Point at Your Mac

excerpt.zh: bigarrow让AI代理在Mac屏幕上绘制箭头、方框和文字，帮助用户完成必须由人确认的操作，但它不会点击、输入或截屏。
excerpt.en: bigarrow lets AI agents place arrows, boxes, and text on a Mac screen for human-guided steps, while deliberately avoiding clicks, typing, and screenshots.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: bigarrow把AI代理的提示放到屏幕上
text.en: bigarrow puts AI agent guidance on the screen

text.zh: bigarrow是一款面向macOS的命令行工具，也提供Claude Code和Codex技能。AI代理遇到“点击Allow”“选择正确标签页”这类必须由用户完成的步骤时，可以在目标窗口上方绘制醒目的箭头、方框和说明文字，让提示直接出现在用户需要查看的位置。
text.en: bigarrow is a macOS command-line tool with skills for Claude Code and Codex. When an AI agent reaches a step the user must perform, such as clicking Allow or choosing the right tab, it can draw a prominent arrow, box, and instruction over the target window instead of leaving a message in an unattended terminal.

text.zh: bigarrow如何连接代理与人工确认
text.en: How bigarrow connects agents with human confirmation

text.zh: 工具使用一个透明、置顶且可穿透点击的窗口显示标注，支持按界面元素、窗口、坐标或鼠标位置定位，也能在操作完成后自动消失。它不需要专门的绘图权限；命令支持持续时间、停止、JSON输出、复制文字和语音朗读等选项，适合权限提示、双因素认证、验证码、支付确认、教学演示和远程协助。
text.en: The tool uses a transparent always-on-top window whose overlay does not intercept clicks. Agents can target an accessibility element, window, coordinate, or mouse position, and annotations can disappear automatically. Commands also support time limits, explicit stopping, JSON output, copyable text, and speech. The design fits permission prompts, two-factor authentication, CAPTCHAs, payment confirmations, tutorials, and remote assistance.

text.zh: bigarrow的边界比自动化更重要
text.en: bigarrow’s limits are part of its design

text.zh: bigarrow刻意只负责指路：它不会点击、输入或捕获屏幕，因此不能独立完成需要人工授权的流程。这个限制降低了代理误操作的范围，也保留了用户对敏感步骤的决定权，但同时意味着体验仍取决于用户是否注意到标注并及时操作。项目是纯Swift二进制，采用MIT许可证；从源码构建需要Xcode 16及以上和macOS 14及以上。
text.en: bigarrow deliberately only points: it does not click, type, or capture the screen, so it cannot complete a human-authorized workflow on its own. That boundary limits accidental agent actions and preserves user control over sensitive steps, but the experience still depends on the user noticing and responding to the annotation. The project is a pure Swift binary under the MIT license; source builds require Xcode 16 or later and macOS 14 or later.
